# 1.21.2 DimLib test dependency

`dimlib-source` was copied from the iPortalTeam DimLib repository's `1.21.3` branch (commit `467e83b`) and adapted locally to Minecraft 1.21.2 with Fabric API `0.106.1+1.21.2`. The upstream source and its Apache 2.0 `LICENSE` are included. `dimlib-1.1.0+mc1.21.2.jar` is the resulting local test build (SHA-256 `6C2599710DB3D1641DF004611D1CD9FB7A49C65DD97BBB78CD6CCF21B5669D3B`).

This is an interim dependency for the Fabric port; it is not an upstream DimLib release. Changes to the source require rebuilding the JAR and updating the hash before release.
